svg.text: No zoom: a unit is always 128 high. The window's width is the rack's: vents take up what the frames don't need; frames that don't fit go on to another unit.
Faces 720 wide: the frames wrap, a card's two frames 2U, the 18i8 5U.
One rack: frames on one unit where they fit, the 18i8 2U; the rest vents.
Two 19″ racks side by side: devices down the first, on into the second.
Frames go in order, outputs left and inputs right in each unit; a unit full, the next ones go on to one more (under the ID block: vents).
Two racks once the window has room for two 19" ones (1390 each, at 1.75" a unit); the devices split where the two come out evenest.
Only the wheel moves it: up and down. The narrowest window: the ID block and the widest frame (about 520).
